set.25.style: Completely NEW original virtuosic modern piano and cinematic strings toccata, 148 BPM, E minor. Avoid repeated 4-bar ostinato. Section A: angular syncopated four-note rising motif with wide interval leaps, intricate fast runs, left hand cross-rhythms. Section B: entirely contrasting lyrical melody in G major with long sustained violin counter-melody and legato piano chords. Section C: dramatic return in altered rhythm and key, inventive harmonic modulations, cinematic crescendo. Surprising rests, strong cadence, new ideas every eight bars. No singing or voices. IMPORTANT: strict valid ABC notation. Every 4/4 bar must have exactly 32 units at L:1/32, no overfull measures, consistent V: Vocal and V: Ins, correct note lengths and bars. Compose genuinely contrasting sections, no repeated 4-bar loops.
